# Papers

The papers the project builds on. [`papers.yaml`](papers.yaml) is the source of truth (arXiv
id, pinned version, exact title, role). `uv run python papers/download_papers.py` downloads the
PDFs to `papers/pdf/` (git-ignored), checks each title against the first page, and regenerates
the table below.
